--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -13,4 +13,29 @@
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Input validation
+    if not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray):
+        raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays")
+    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
+        raise ValueError("Inputs must be two-dimensional matrices")
+    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
+        raise ValueError("Inputs must have the same shape")
+    if logp_with_result.size == 0:
+        raise ValueError("Inputs cannot be empty")
+    if not np.isfinite(logp_with_result).all() or not np.isfinite(logp_call_only).all() or not np.isfinite(logp_no_call).all():
+        raise ValueError("Inputs must be finite")
+    if np.any(logp_with_result > 0) or np.any(logp_call_only > 0) or np.any(logp_no_call > 0):
+        raise ValueError("Inputs must be nonpositive")
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError("Threshold cannot be boolean")
+    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("Threshold must be finite and nonnegative")
+
+    # Compute margins (reduction in loss from no_call to with_result)
+    margin = np.sum(logp_with_result - logp_no_call, axis=1)
+    # Compute second margin (reduction from call_only to with_result)
+    margin2 = np.sum(logp_with_result - logp_call_only, axis=1)
+    # Keep if both margins exceed threshold
+    keep = (margin > tau_filter) & (margin2 > tau_filter)
+    # Return primary margin
+    return keep, margin
